description: Ask ChatGPT to make a page, a report or a small app, and ShipStatic puts it online. You get a link you can share right away. You don't need an account. A site published without one stays up for 3 days, and its claim link lets you keep it. Want it private? Ask for built-in password protection, and visitors have to type the password before they see anything. If you have a ShipStatic account, connect it to keep every site, see them all and use your own domain.
